title: Schriever's 1944 disc flight

tellings.quote: And you have Rudolf Schriever and I think, you know, saying that in 1944, we finally flew this craft and it rose to, you know, 40,000 ft in a few minutes.

Miethe's contemporary, German technician Rudolf Schriever, claims to have worked on a disc-shaped craft in Prague that made its first flight test in February of 1945, climbing to 40,000 ft in 3 minutes.
tellings.difference: Dates the first flight to February 1945 rather than 1944, places it in Prague and specifies 3 minutes.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Schriever's claim that his disc flew and climbed to 40,000 ft in minutes.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a German engineer named Rudolf Schriever claimed that in 1944, in Nazi Germany, his team finally flew a disc-shaped craft and it rose to 40,000 feet in a few minutes. If true, it would mean flying saucers were being built by humans before the first big UFO reports.
